aboutUsParagraph1: Don Rifa is an innovative digital lottery platform that helps individuals, entrepreneurs, and organizations raise funds and promote products through digital raffles.
aboutUsParagraph2: Founded in Puerto Rico, Don Rifa currently operates in the United States, Mexico, and the Dominican Republic, with plans to expand to eight additional Latin American countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Peru, and Uruguay.
aboutUsParagraph3: We offer a modern, secure, and transparent solution for managing digital raffles, allowing businesses and individuals to reach new audiences and generate income through the distribution of high-value products like cars, apartments, luxury watches, motorcycles, and more.
aboutUsParagraph4: Don Rifa has been supported by prestigious business accelerators (Grupo Guayacán, Parallel 18) and emphasizes its digital-first approach, 100% online operations via mobile app and website, and automated processes ensuring traceability, security, and trust.
aboutUsParagraph5: Our mission is to democratize access to quality raffles, foster entrepreneurship, and support social causes legally and responsibly.
